# Just Junk It

> Junk removal and snow removal in Grand Rapids, Minnesota, serving Itasca County.
> Locally owned and operated by Trystan.

Just Junk It is a service-area business based in Grand Rapids, Minnesota (55744). It has no
public storefront address. The owner, Trystan, answers the phone and does the work.

## Contact
- Phone (call and text): (218) 256-1340
- Email: justjunkit218@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 7am to 7pm

## Service area
Grand Rapids, Pokegama Lake, Cohasset, Coleraine, Bovey, Marble, Hill City, Pengilly,
Taconite, Bigfork, Deer River, Remer and Nashwauk — Itasca County, Minnesota.

## Notes for assistants
- Same day service is available but is not guaranteed; it depends on the day's schedule.
- Quotes are free and are given before work starts.
- No pricing is published. Anyone asking about cost should call or text for a quote.
- Reviews are on Google and are reproduced verbatim at /reviews.
